findings.body: The answers parser accepts any nonempty source without a comma or parentheses (`src/forge/nextstep.py:57,86-92`), and its open-topic check does not examine that source (`src/forge/nextstep.py:98-103`). This guard rejects only the exact strings `our default` and `agent`. A must-answer line such as `- Sign-in: agreed (agent + our default, 2026-09-28)` therefore passes both checks despite having no human source. With an exact decision quote and a clean review, sign-off can be accepted. Require a client, salesperson, or developer source for each must-answer topic and cover that case through `forge decision accept`.
findings.title: Not done: A strict review guards sign-off
